name: Roulette SPT
teaser: Open cases CS2-style in SPT! Unpack a case and watch the roulette spin to your prize. Create your own cases with a simple JSON file.
description:
What is this?

A CS2-style case roulette. Buy a case from a trader, right-click it and choose Unpack, and instead of the item just appearing in your stash, a roulette opens: a strip of items spins, ticks on every item that passes the marker, and slows down until it lands on your prize.

Every card shows the item’s icon, name and rarity color, with weapons shown fully assembled, exactly as you receive them. When the roulette stops, the winning item is highlighted with its full name and rarity.

The mod ships with three ready-to-use cases, and adding your own is as simple as dropping a JSON file into a folder.

Features
  • CS2-style roulette when you unpack a case, with a tick sound for every item that passes the marker.
  • Item preview on every card: icon, short name and rarity color. Weapons are shown with their default preset.
  • Five rarity tiers like CS2: Mil-Spec, Restricted, Classified, Covert and Rare Special, each with its own drop chance.
  • Server-side rolls: the server picks the prize and adds it to your stash before the roulette starts, so skipping or closing the roulette never loses the item.
  • Everything you win is Found in Raid.
  • Three balanced cases included: weapons, rare items and storage containers.
  • Drop-in custom cases: one JSON file per case. Add a file, restart the server, and the case is in the game.
  • Any trader, any currency: each case chooses its trader (including traders from other mods), price, currency, loyalty level, stock and buy limit.
  • Skip straight to the result with the SKIP button or Esc.
Included Cases

All three are sold by Peacekeeper at loyalty level 1, with unlimited stock.

  • Roulette weapon case — $660. 22 weapons, from a Makarov to an M60E6, given with their default preset.
  • Roulette rare items case — $925. 21 valuables: figurines, GPU, LEDX, Bitcoin and Labs keycards up to Red.
  • Roulette storage containers case — $2,550. 21 storage containers, from wallets to the T H I C C item case.

Drop chances per tier:

  • Mil-Spec — 79.92%
  • Restricted — 15.98%
  • Classified — 3.2%
  • Covert — 0.64%
  • Rare Special — 0.26%

A tier’s chance is split evenly between the case’s items in that tier.

Custom Cases

Each case is its own JSON file in SPT_Runtime/user/mods/rouletteSPT/cases/. To add one, drop a new .json file in that folder and restart the server. A broken file is reported in the server log and skipped, without affecting the other cases.

{
  "id": "6abc5a3f2257651f5af5d5d8",
  "cloneFrom": "64897ffc3656831810043165",
  "backgroundColor": "violet",
  "handbookPriceRoubles": 79860,
  "locales": {
    "en": { "name": "My case", "shortName": "MyCase", "description": "Open it to spin the roulette." }
  },
  "trader": { "traderId": "5935c25fb3acc3127c3d8cd9", "price": 660, "currency": "USD", "loyaltyLevel": 1, "stock": -1, "buyRestriction": 0 },
  "items": [
    { "tpl": "5448bd6b4bdc2dfc2f8b4569", "tier": "milspec" },
    { "tpl": "627e14b21713922ded6f2c15", "tier": "gold" }
  ]
}

Fields:

  • id — id of the new case item: a unique 24-character hex MongoId. Never change it once players own the case.
  • cloneFrom — item whose model, icon and size the case copies.
  • backgroundColor — inventory background: blue, yellow, green, red, black, grey, violet, orange or default.
  • handbookPriceRoubles — handbook and flea base price, in roubles.
  • locales — name, short name and description per game language. Missing languages use the first one.
  • trader — where the case is sold:
    • traderId — the trader’s id (see below).
    • price and currency — USD, RUB, EUR or GP.
    • loyaltyLevel — loyalty level needed to buy it.
    • stock — stock per restock; -1 is unlimited.
    • buyRestriction — max purchases per restock; 0 is no limit.
  • items — what the case can give, one item per opening. tier is one of milspec, restricted, classified, covert or gold.

Trader ids:

  • Prapor — 54cb50c76803fa8b248b4571
  • Therapist — 54cb57776803fa99248b456e
  • Skier — 58330581ace78e27b8b10cee
  • Peacekeeper — 5935c25fb3acc3127c3d8cd9
  • Mechanic — 5a7c2eca46aef81a7ca2145d
  • Ragman — 5ac3b934156ae10c4430e83c
  • Jaeger — 5c0647fdd443bc2504c2d371

Traders added by other mods work too. Fence isn’t supported, since his stock is generated by the server.

The rarity tiers (names, colors and chances) are in config.json and shared by every case.

Installation
  1. Download the latest release from the Files tab.
  2. Extract rouletteSPT.zip into your SPT game folder. It places:
    • the server mod in SPT_Runtime/user/mods/rouletteSPT/
    • the client plugin in BepInEx/plugins/rouletteSPT.dll
  3. Start the server and the game, buy a case from Peacekeeper, right-click it and choose Unpack.

Client settings (F12 menu):

  • Enable Roulette (default true) — when off, cases open like a normal container.
  • Spin Duration (default 6.5) — how long the roulette spins, in seconds (2–15).
Requirements
  • SPT 4.1.6.
  • Both parts of the mod (server and client). The client reads the cases from the server when the game starts; without the server mod, the roulette stays off.
  • Enough free space in your stash for the prize. If there isn’t enough space, the case stays unopened.
Issues

Found a problem? Open an issue on GitHub.
